# Reference definitions

CommonMark 4.7 allows a line ending between a definition's label, its
destination and its title, so a definition can occupy several lines.

See [the docs][docs] and [the guide][guide] here, plus [wide] and [tall].

[docs]:
  /docs
  'Documentation'

[guide]: /guide
  "A guide"

[wide]:  /wide  (Wide)

[tall]: <tall page> 'Tall'
